title: Leidos Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: Leidos Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 announcing that its subsidiary Leidos, Inc. entered into a Contribution and Equity Purchase Agreement with affiliates of Altaris, LLC to form a new joint venture. The JV will combine Leidos's Security Enterprise Solutions and Industrial Automation businesses with Analogic Corporation (a portfolio company of Altaris). Leidos will receive 41.5% equity in the JV; Altaris affiliates will receive 58.5%. The transaction is expected to close in the second half of 2026, subject to regulatory approvals including Hart-Scott-Rodino clearance.
key_points: Leidos, Inc. entered into a Contribution and Equity Purchase Agreement on April 14, 2026 with Altaris, LLC affiliates
